_meta.purpose: Reusable n8n Code+HTTP node pair that emits a kernel audit row to governance-plugin/state/audit.db via the kernel.audit_emit HTTP endpoint, with HMAC-token authentication and the F-12 parent_id composition '<stream_id>:<n8n_node_id>'.
_meta.usage: Import the two nodes below into any n8n workflow that needs to emit audit events. Wire your workflow's data into the Code node input. The Code node computes parent_id, attaches required fields, and signs the row; the HTTP node POSTs to kernel.audit_emit and returns the event_id.
credentials_required: KERNEL_AUDIT_TOKEN env var (HMAC shared secret per RC-5). NOT stored in this template — operator configures via n8n credentials store or env.
_meta.endpoint: POST {KERNEL_AUDIT_ENDPOINT}/audit/emit (default http://localhost:5681/audit/emit; governance-plugin Phase N exposes this).
error_codes: AUDIT-001 unsigned_row — HMAC token missing or invalid (governance write boundary rejects)
KER-AE-001 audit.db unreachable — endpoint cannot reach the database
KER-AE-002 missing required payload field — schema validation failed at endpoint
KER-AE-003 audit_hmac_token_missing — env var KERNEL_AUDIT_TOKEN absent
KER-AE-004 audit_payload_mixed_forms — prompt + prompt_ref both supplied

_integration_notes.fallback_when_endpoint_unavailable: If kernel.audit_emit HTTP endpoint is not yet shipped by governance-plugin (Phase N), operators may swap the second node for an n8n-nodes-base.executeCommand node that shells out to: sqlite3 ~/Code/governance-plugin/state/audit.db "INSERT INTO audit_events ...". This is a v0.1.0-only workaround; Phase N's HMAC-token boundary is the production path.
_integration_notes.kernel_audit_endpoint_responsibility: The HTTP endpoint kernel.audit_emit is owned by governance-plugin (per RC-5 implementation coordination note in API.md §6). The kernel publishes the contract; governance-plugin lands the listener. Until then, operators run the executeCommand fallback OR import the rows via a cron task that drains a queue file.
_integration_notes.credential_lifecycle: KERNEL_AUDIT_TOKEN is a kernel-managed HMAC shared secret. It rotates on operator policy. Distribution to n8n is operator's responsibility — typical patterns: (a) Docker compose env var, (b) n8n Credential 'Header Auth' wrapping a static value, (c) HashiCorp Vault integration via the n8n Vault node. The TEMPLATE NEVER stores the token.
_integration_notes.f12_parent_id_validation: The Code node enforces the F-12 pattern '<stream_id>:<n8n_node_id>' via regex BEFORE signing. Any audit row that fails the pattern is rejected at the emitter, preventing malformed parent_ids from reaching the audit bus.
_integration_notes.trace_id_propagation: Workflows that span multiple stages must propagate trace_id explicitly. Pattern: the first node in a workflow chain reads trace_id from $('Webhook').first().json.headers['x-trace-id'] or generates a UUID; subsequent audit emissions inherit it via $('Build Audit Row').first().json.auditRow.trace_id.
